title: 大订单①：把“像大平台”写成验收单
titleEn: Big order I: define what “like a platform” means
description: 孵化器的社区书店想把预约、会员、推荐和在线付款一口气做完。请整理采访记录，列出本次范围、明确排除项和逐条可检查的验收条件。客户先要的是共同理解，不是更多功能。
descriptionEn: The incubator bookshop asks for bookings, memberships, recommendations and payments at once. Turn interviews into scope, exclusions and testable acceptance criteria. They need shared understanding before more features.

requirements.label: 只覆盖一家门店；会员付款、跨店调货不在本次范围内
requirements.labelEn: One shop only; membership payments and cross-shop stock transfers are excluded

title: 大订单②：预约系统，两次交付
titleEn: Big order II: booking system in two deliveries
description: 第1期交付可演示的预约流程；第2期修正重复预约、时区和取消记录。每期都要验收，等待反馈期间团队仍被合同占用。没有支付、推荐算法或即时聊天，别把“以后可以做”算进这次工期。
descriptionEn: Phase one demonstrates bookings. Phase two handles duplicates, time zones and cancellations. Both phases require acceptance and retain the team during feedback. Payments, recommendations and chat are excluded.

title: 大订单②：先把店员手册交到手上
titleEn: Big order II: the staff handbook comes first
description: 第1期把店员最常遇到的预约问题整理成有出处的操作手册；第2期根据试营业记录核查例外情况。采用现有表单，不承诺自动化平台。资料复核需要知识与写作，审查者应确认回答能追溯到原记录。
descriptionEn: First deliver a sourced booking handbook; then verify edge cases against the pilot log. Use existing forms instead of promising an automated platform. Knowledge and writing matter; review should trace answers to the original records.

title: 大订单③：带着真实账单去路演
titleEn: Big order III: pitch with real delivery bills
description: 用已交付的案例说明客户得到什么、没得到什么，以及云端额度、本地电费和人手占用。不要把预付款当利润，也不要承诺无限免费维护。路演材料验收后，客户会留下可供投资人核对的交付记录。
descriptionEn: Explain what the client received and what was excluded, with cloud usage, electricity and staffing costs. Advances are not profit and maintenance is not unlimited. The accepted pitch leaves a delivery record investors can verify.
